feature: Custom auth PR 7 · the invite code screen (/auth/code)
note: Boards: design/design_handoff_custom_auth/boards/04-invite-code (code-plain-m, code-typing-m, code-prefilled-m, code-320, code-d, code-light-m). Signed out. Photographed with no API: the empty field, a code being typed (the paste hint), a whole code (Looks good), and a code arriving in the link (You're invited). The answers need the redeem API and are hand-walked on staging: busy (code-busy-m), not found, used (with its sign-in link), expired (with its waitlist link), too many tries (code-ratelimit-m: the field locks and the button counts down from 3:00), and the ended page (its own inventory, code-ended-way-back.json). The By continuing you agree line stays until the cutover, so it is drawn here and not on the boards.
